parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end of the time range to query. Unit: milliseconds.

parameters.name: Filter
parameters.description:
The filter condition. Three types of filter conditions are provided:

*   Application name: pid (Note that the application name is displayed, but the application ID is actually specified)
*   Application type: siteType
*   Data type: dataType

parameters.name: Group
parameters.description:
The grouping fields. Valid values:

*   siteType: The total number of OCUs is grouped by application type.
*   dataType: The total number of OCUs is grouped by data type.
*   pid: The total number of OCUs is grouped by application ID.
*   appName: The total number of OCUs is grouped by application name.
*   startTime: The total number of OCUs is grouped by start time.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page.

parameters.name: QueryType
parameters.description: The type of the query. To query non-time series data, set the value to INSTANT. To query time series data, set the value to TIME_SERIES.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The beginning of the time range to query. Unit: milliseconds.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun arms get-rum-ocu-statistic-data --start-time 1600063200000 --end-time 1687849260000 --query-type TIME_SERIES --filter Value=b590xxxxx@2dcbxxxxx9_,_b590xxxxx@2dcbxxxxx8 OpType=in Key=pid --group siteType --page 1 --page-size 100 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2019-08-08 --region cn-hangzhou
